title: Bimini Road Enigma

scenes.text: A submerged stone formation resembling a road was photographed in 1968
The structure stretches roughly 0.5 km and consists of over 30 limestone blocks
Original 1968 photograph taken by a local diver
Geologists suggest it’s a natural reef; others claim an ancient Atlantean road
scenes.label: Natural or Ancient?
scenes.sub: The alignment and flatness fuel the debate, but no consensus exists

scenes.text: Follow if the unknown keeps you up at night.

description: Bimini Road has intrigued explorers for decades, sitting at the crossroads of geology and legend. Discover why its origin remains unresolved.
